# RR and Sons Building Solution PVT LTD

> India's premier engineer-led house lifting, building relocation, and foundation engineering company. Established in 2005.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: RR and Sons Building Solution PVT LTD
- **Website**: https://myhouselifting.com
- **Headquarters**: 69-C, Kalsi, P.O. Nilokheri, Karnal District, Haryana 132117, India
- **Founders**: Gurdeep Kumar (Civil Engineer) & Sandeep Kumar (Mechanical Engineer)
- **Primary Phone**: +91 9494160000 / +91 9491160000
- **Email**: info@myhouselifting.com
- **Operating Scope**: Pan-India execution across all 28 states and union territories

## Core Engineering Services
1. **House Lifting & Elevation**:
   - Elevate existing single and multi-storey structures from 2 ft up to 14 ft above revised road level or recurring flood lines without interior demolition or structural dismantling.
   - Synchronized mechanical jack arrays with continuous laser leveling maintaining tolerances within ±2 mm across all support points.
2. **Building Shifting & Relocation**:
   - Horizontal relocation of residential houses, heritage structures, temples, and commercial buildings along precision ground track beams.
   - India Book of Records holder for rotating a multi-storey building 90 degrees.
3. **Stilt Parking Excavation & Retrofitting**:
   - Creating stilt parking under existing buildings by lifting the structure 8 to 12 ft and pouring reinforced concrete columns and foundation pads.
4. **Foundation Repair & Underpinning**:
   - Correcting differential settlement, foundational cracking, and sub-base subsidence using pressure grouting, micro-piling, and RCC beam jacketing.

## Safety & Legal Guarantee
- **Court Legal Agreement**: Every project is bound by a registered judicial stamp paper agreement guaranteeing 100% structural safety with zero crack damage.
- **Warranty**: 10-year comprehensive structural warranty on all elevated foundations and newly cast RCC pedestals.
- **Track Record**: Over 2,500 structures successfully lifted and relocated across India since 2005.
